body: Refresh the framework's frontend pins and locked backend dependencies ahead of Reflex 0.10.0. Generated apps use React 19.3, Vite 8.3.2, Bun 1.4.2, and updated Socket.IO, Shiki, Moment, Radix, upload, and error-boundary packages. Locked backend updates include Starlette 1.7, Granian 2.8.3, Pydantic 2.13.5, python-socketio 5.17, and wrapt 2.5. Refresh the uv and docs Bun lockfiles and add news fragments for all six affected packages. Preserve all existing dependency lower bounds, including workspace sibling floors; the framework does not require newer library APIs. Regenerating component stubs leaves `pyi_hashes.json` unchanged. ### Compatibility - Preserve the existing Redis, Plotly, Tailwind, and externally owned frontend holds, and retain the seven-day backend release delay. - Update react-dropzone to 17.0.0; hold 18+ because they change MIME fallback handling and over-limit upload batch acceptance. - Widen the wrapt upper bound to `<2.6` to allow 2.4 and 2.5. - Lock SQLModel to 0.0.44 and cap it below 0.0.45. The newer default UTC storage rejects existing naive datetime values; the existing migration test reproduced the break. - Remove the obsolete react-moment hold and update version-sensitive test fixtures. ### Validation - Full unit suite on Python 3.14.6 with Node 22.22.3: **11,252 passed, 159 skipped; 78.99% coverage**. - Existing upload and Moment browser integration tests: **18 passed**. - Temporary production app with a fresh Bun 1.4.2 installation: build, Shiki rendering, Radix slider/progress, upload, Moment, and Socket.IO state event roundtrip passed. - Dependency checker tests after restoring the original floors: **91 passed**; verified all original lower bounds and resolved package versions are preserved. - Minimum-dependency checks for `reflex` and `reflex-base` on Python 3.10 passed. - Ruff lint, formatting, and `pyright reflex tests` passed. - Adversarial diff review completed with no remaining findings. The all-files pre-commit run stops at six macOS typing errors in unchanged Linux benchmark code (`sched_setaffinity`, `sched_getaffinity`, and `psutil.Process.cpu_affinity`). The required `pyright reflex tests` check passes. Staged-file pre-commit hooks passed, including codespell, stub generation, pyright, and ty.
title: Refresh framework dependencies ahead of 0.10.0
